summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting an agreement to issue and sell $1,000,000 aggregate principal amount of convertible promissory notes to existing CLA Investors at 90% of par ($900,000 cash), with a floor price amendment to $1.875 per share. The transaction closes on or about June 14, 2026. This is a structured financing (convertible note at a discount) and not a special situation; it lacks a change of control, activist campaign, strategic review, or liquidation. The filing is a routine capital raise disclosure under Rule 13a-16, not a transformative event.
